newsitem.title: FRANCE: Morgan says placed Valeo shrs.
newsitem.headline: Morgan says placed Valeo shrs.

text.p: U.S. investment bank JP Morgan said on Wednesday that it and CDC Marches placed 2.541 million shares of Valeo at a price of 368 franc per share.

It said the seller of the shares was Arkaig, a Dutch company set up as a financing vehicle at the time of the purchase by CGIP of a 20 percent stake in Valeo from French investment company Cerus in November 1996.
JP Morgan did not name on Wednesday the buyer of the shares.

"JP Morgan and CDC Marches today announced the block placement to institutional investors of 2,541,000 Valeo shares owned by Arkaig Finance Company BV, at Ffr 368 per share. Arkaig Finance Company BV is a special purpose vehicle that was holding the Valeo shares bought by JP Morgan GT Corporation in November 1996," JP Morgan said in a statement.

"In connection with the sale of the Valeo shares by Arkaig, JP Morgan unwound the equity swap agreement with Oranje-Nassau Groep BV a subsidiary of Compagnie Generale d'Industrie et de Participations (CGIP)."
Cerus, a French investment firm controlled by Italian businessman Carlo de Benedetti, said on November 5 that it sold its 28-percent share of Valeo.

At the time, French state-owned bank Caisse des Depots et Consignation (CDC) increased its share in Valeo to about 5.4 percent from 1.9 percent and investment fund JP Morgan GT Corp bought about 3.63 percent of Valeo.
JP Morgan GT Corp said when it bought the shares in Valeo last November that it would sell them in three to five years.
